Name: Froststar11's Barn Signs for Custom Furniture
Author: froststar11
Description:
[b][u]Installation:[/u][/b]

Unzip directly into your Mods folder and enjoy. You can find these signs at Robin's shop for sale, or spawn them in through the item catalogue. 

[b][u]Requirements: [/u][/b]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url] (So you can load the items into the game)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2276]Furniture Anywhere[/url] (So you can place any furniture outside)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Entoarox Framework[/url] (because it's required by one of the other three)

Downloads.Description: Download and unzip into your StardewValley/Mods folder. Enjoy! You can purchase your new signs from Robin or snag them from the item catalogue.

Manifest.Name: Barn Signs
Manifest.Description: A CF pack that adds signs for each animal to the game.
